name: short-drama-novel-studio
description: 本地优先、可审片、可复现、可交付的 AI 漫剧生产工作室

scripts.db:generate: echo 'Database schema generation is owned by the new HTTP server.'
scripts.db:push: echo 'Database migrations are intentionally disabled for the fresh v3 database.'
scripts.test:unit: bun test --cwd apps/desktop/electron && bun test --cwd packages/app && bun run test:runtime
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit
scripts.test:runtime:node: node --import tsx node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run packages/bundles/src/index.test.ts packages/server-connection/src/index.test.ts packages/kernel/src/index.test.ts packages/database/src/cutover.test.ts packages/desktop-host/src/agent-runtime.test.ts packages/runtime/src/providers.test.ts packages/runtime/src/workspace-writing.test.ts plugins/system/src/index.test.ts
scripts.test:runtime:bun: bunx vitest run packages/bundles/src/index.test.ts packages/server-connection/src/index.test.ts packages/kernel/src/index.test.ts packages/database/src/cutover.test.ts packages/desktop-host/src/agent-runtime.test.ts packages/runtime/src/providers.test.ts packages/runtime/src/workspace-writing.test.ts plugins/system/src/index.test.ts
scripts.test:runtime: bun run test:runtime:node && bun run test:runtime:bun
scripts.format: bunx prettier --write README.md package.json playwright.config.ts tests/electron tsconfig.base.json apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts apps/desktop/electron apps/desktop/scripts apps/desktop/tsconfig*.json packages plugins profiles scripts/check-runtime-architecture.mjs
scripts.format:check: bunx prettier --check README.md package.json playwright.config.ts tests/electron tsconfig.base.json apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts apps/desktop/electron apps/desktop/scripts apps/desktop/tsconfig*.json packages plugins profiles scripts/check-runtime-architecture.mjs
